systems.platform: Android app with web dashboard, developed by Techmerge
systems.owner: Ghana Education Service (mSRC desk), with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: head teachers and circuit supervisors submit weekly and termly; district, regional and head office read the dashboard; public basic schools in 20 pilot districts, 1,880 schools by end March 2018
annual census of all basic, secondary and post-secondary institutions, public and private; collected manually, with EMIS software pilot-tested in three districts

note: No fact: the mSRC carries school-level totals each week (enrolment by class, pupil and teacher attendance counts, class performance by subject), not a record per learner, and the report calls it a pilot in 20 of 216 districts; the EMIS it describes is the annual census.
